0a.note: Source is a supplied transcript, so Phase 0a (OCR) does not apply. Part 1's TurboScribe export stopped at exactly 10.000h against 10.273h of audio -- a hard export ceiling that left 16.4 min untranscribed. That tail was cut from the MP3, transcribed with Azure fast transcription (163 phrases, 2,146 words) and spliced into both the .txt and the .vtt at offset 35998.830s. Coverage is now 99.9% and 100.0%; both VTTs parse monotonic through _transcript.from_vtt (10,022 and 9,784 cues).
